To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The miniMD benchmark is highly parallel and can be accelerated with SIMD; (2) The original miniMD implementation is not optimised to take advantage of SIMD; (3) We present a new miniMD implementation which uses SIMD to accelerate the code; (4) The new implementation is up to five times faster than the original implementation; and (5) We show that adding an Intel®XeonPhi™coprocessor can increase performance by another factor of two.
we have identified and implemented novel optimisations for SIMD execution of molecular dynamics codes.
